On the first episode of UFC 334 Embedded, Bantamweight Champion Kayla Harrison and Chris Duncan train together at ATT; Caio Borralho gets a visit from his stepfather at the gym; Amanda Nunes picks up her kids from school; Kevin Holland spars while wrapping up his camp; Heavyweight Champion Ciryl Gane visits the NY Giants practice facility; Josh Hokit gets ready for his first UFC title fight at Jackson Wink.
 UFC 334 takes place at Madison Square Garden and features two world title bouts. A heavyweight title bout between champion Ciryl Gane and undefeated Josh Hokit headlines the event. In the co-main event, bantamweight champion Kayla Harrison faces former two-division titleholder Amanda Nunes.
